$comment: The SMOKE tier: `pnpm test:smoke`. Read docs/testing/TIERS.md before editing. Every file here must exist and reach at least `minWidth` distinct src/ modules through its imports — tests/unit/smoke-list.test.ts holds the list to that, so a narrow test cannot be added by accident. Width is measured by tools/test/import-graph.mjs; `node tools/test/tiered.mjs --list` prints it. `why` is for the reader; nothing parses it.

files.why: All thirteen missions flown for 30 s of sim time under both presets through the same per-tick calls boot/app.ts makes: autopilot, flight model, scorer, levers, speed chain, boundary, medal arithmetic. No assets needed. The one that goes red first when a sim function breaks.
int_01_hoverJet flown to COMPLETION — every gate, in order, inside the time limit. The claim the 30 s window above cannot make.
The scoring loop end to end on a synthetic path: exact platinum, the time bonus, the finish gate, DEV-003/004's medal arithmetic.
Sampling a 2016 recording — the ghost pipeline from quantised JSON to a pose, and the yaw that flew backwards once. 50 modules wide through the render seam.
The holotables: the mission index, paging, the gaze pick and the confirm. The player's only route into a mission.
The game/jumpseat-flight seam that reads the level — the pad table, the finish slab, the refuel spheres — for the second vehicle.
The elevator ride and the reveal that gates the world draw: launch, hangar, shaft and the timing between them.
Every input device held against the constants sheet's control scheme — the DEV-069 lesson, cheap, and the only smoke entry that compares the port against something outside it.
